verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own OSS server can be deployed headlessly from a downloadable Docker compose file, and community users confirm running it in Docker. Nothing documents running the client or remote-control actions headlessly, scripting it, or using it in CI pipelines. The Pro management API and unattended access belong to other stories and are not credited here. Missing for 10: a headless or CLI client mode, documented CI usage, a scriptable automation interface, and hands-on corroboration of automated (not just self-hosted) operation.
